title: Сослагательное наклонение: suggest that he be, It's time you went, I'd rather you did

why: В русском для желаний и рекомендаций есть «бы» («Я бы хотел, чтобы ты пришёл»). В английском есть несколько конструкций, где после определённых слов глагол принимает особую форму, и это не совсем то, что вы ожидаете. Они часто встречаются в деловой речи и в формальных текстах.
formation: • Mandative subjunctive (формальный): suggest / recommend / insist / demand / propose / require + that + подлежащее + БАЗОВАЯ форма глагола (без -s и без to). Отрицание: that he not go. Британский вариант: should + глагол.
• It's (high / about) time + подлежащее + Past Simple: It's time you went.
• would rather + подлежащее + Past Simple (о настоящем и будущем) или Past Perfect (о прошлом): I'd rather you stayed. I'd rather you hadn't said that.
• Если подлежащее одно и то же: I'd rather go. (без that и без Past Simple)
usage: 1. Рекомендация, требование, предложение. (The manager suggested that he be present. = Менеджер предложил, чтобы он присутствовал. / We recommend that she see a doctor. = Мы рекомендуем, чтобы она обратилась к врачу.) Заметьте: she see, а не she sees.

2. It's time + Past Simple означает «пора, чтобы кто-то сделал», при этом смысл настоящий. (It's time you went to bed. = Тебе пора идти спать. / It's high time we fixed this bug. = Давно пора исправить этот баг.)

3. I'd rather + кто-то сделал: предпочёл бы, чтобы кто-то сделал или не сделал. (I'd rather you didn't smoke here. = Я бы предпочёл, чтобы вы здесь не курили. / I'd rather you called me tomorrow. = Лучше позвоните мне завтра.)
4. I'd rather + Past Perfect: сожаление о прошлом. (I'd rather you hadn't told her. = Лучше бы ты ей не говорил.)
signalWords: suggest, recommend, insist, demand, propose, require, request, it's important / essential / vital that, it's time, it's high time, would rather, would sooner.
mistakes: ✗ He suggested that she goes. → ✓ He suggested that she go. В формальном стиле после suggest нужна базовая форма.
✗ It's time you to go. → ✓ It's time you went. После you идёт Past Simple, а не инфинитив.
✗ It's time you go home. → ✓ It's time you went home. Это Past Simple, хотя речь о настоящем.
✗ I'd rather you to stay. → ✓ I'd rather you stayed. После would rather нет to.
✗ I'd rather you didn't say that. (о прошлом) → ✓ I'd rather you hadn't said that. Если речь о прошлом, нужен Past Perfect.
remember: После suggest/insist/demand that: базовая форма (he be, she go). После It's time и I'd rather + другое лицо: Past Simple, но смысл про настоящее.

items.prompt: It's time you ___ (go) to bed.
items.answer: went

items.prompt: The doctor recommended that he ___ (rest) for a week.
items.answer: rest

items.prompt: I'd rather you ___ (not, tell) anyone about this.
items.answer: didn't tell

items.prompt: They insisted that she ___ (be) present at the meeting.
items.answer: be

items.prompt: It's high time we ___ (leave).
items.answer: left

items.prompt: I suggest that he ___ (apply) for the job today.
items.answer: apply

items.prompt: I'd rather you ___ (call) me after lunch.
items.answer: called

items.prompt: The rules require that every user ___ (change) the password.
items.answer: change

items.prompt: She demanded that he (a) apologizes (b) apologize.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: It's time you (a) to start (b) started working.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: I'd rather you (a) stay (b) stayed here tonight.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: It's essential that the report (a) is (b) be ready by Friday.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: I'd rather (a) go (b) to go home now.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: They proposed that the meeting (a) be moved (b) is moved to Monday.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: It's about time he (a) learn (b) learned to drive.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: I'd rather you (a) hadn't (b) didn't said that yesterday.
items.answer: a

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав с данных слов

items.prompt: You should leave now. → It's time ...
items.answer: It's time you left.

items.prompt: I don't want you to open the window. → I'd rather ...
items.answer: I'd rather you didn't open the window.

items.prompt: My boss said, "Please send me the report." → My boss asked that ...
items.answer: My boss asked that I send him the report. / My boss asked that I send her the report. / My boss requested that I send the report.

items.prompt: "You must come with us," she said. → She insisted that ...
items.answer: She insisted that I come with them. / She insisted that he come with them. / She insisted that we come with them.

items.prompt: You should have started the project earlier. → It's high time ...
items.answer: It's high time you started the project.

items.prompt: I regret that you told him the secret. → I'd rather ...
items.answer: I'd rather you hadn't told him the secret.

items.prompt: "Why don't you see a lawyer?" he said to me. → He suggested that ...
items.answer: He suggested that I see a lawyer.

items.prompt: I prefer that Tom doesn't come. → I'd rather ...
items.answer: I'd rather Tom didn't come.

items.prompt: He suggested that she goes to the doctor.
items.answer: He suggested that she go to the doctor.

items.prompt: It's time you to finish your homework.
items.answer: It's time you finished your homework.

items.prompt: I'd rather you to stay at home.
items.answer: I'd rather you stayed at home.

items.prompt: It's time we go home.
items.answer: It's time we went home.

items.prompt: The client insisted that the code is tested again.
items.answer: The client insisted that the code be tested again.

items.prompt: I'd rather you don't park here.
items.answer: I'd rather you didn't park here.

items.prompt: We recommend that he takes a break.
items.answer: We recommend that he take a break.

items.prompt: I'd rather you didn't come to the party last week.
items.answer: I'd rather you hadn't come to the party last week.

items.prompt: Тебе пора начать искать новую работу.
items.answer: It's time you started looking for a new job. / It's time you started to look for a new job.

items.prompt: Я бы предпочёл, чтобы ты не опаздывал на встречи.
items.answer: I'd rather you didn't come late to meetings. / I'd rather you weren't late for meetings. / I'd rather you didn't arrive late to meetings.

items.prompt: Врач порекомендовал, чтобы он больше спал.
items.answer: The doctor recommended that he sleep more. / The doctor recommended that he get more sleep.

items.prompt: Давно пора обновить сайт.
items.answer: It's high time we updated the website. / It's high time the website was updated. / It's high time we updated the site.

items.prompt: Клиент потребовал, чтобы мы закончили проект до пятницы.
items.answer: The client demanded that we finish the project by Friday.

items.prompt: Лучше бы ты мне ничего не говорил вчера.
items.answer: I'd rather you hadn't told me anything yesterday.

items.prompt: Я предлагаю, чтобы она провела презентацию.
items.answer: I suggest that she give the presentation. / I suggest that she do the presentation.

items.prompt: Мне пора ехать домой.
items.answer: It's time I went home.
